title: 飞牛 fnOS DSH 插件
description: 为飞牛 fnOS 维护的 DSH 插件：模型提供方、搜索故障转移、浏览器自动化与系统集成。

description.en: fnOS-specific integrations for DeepSeek Harness: theme following, authorized directories, NAS file access, and session log export.
description.zh: 在飞牛 fnOS 中提供主题跟随、授权目录管理、NAS 文件访问与会话日志导出。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth account management that brings Codex models, usage, and image input into DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 使用 ChatGPT 账户登录 Codex，并把模型、用量和图片输入能力接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Composite web-search provider that fails over TinyFish → Tavily → official DeepSeek, spreads requests across multiple accounts per platform, and shows platform usage on the plugin page.
description.zh: 复合网页搜索提供方：按 TinyFish → Tavily → 官方 DeepSeek 的顺序转移，同一平台的多个账号之间轮转分摊请求，并在插件详情页展示各平台用量。

description.en: Loopback OpenAI-compatible bridge that lets Midscene browser automation use every model already configured in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 托管本地 OpenAI 兼容桥接服务，把 Midscene 浏览器自动化接到 DSH 全部已配置模型。

description.en: Runtime showcase for the shared DSH-themed Semi Design components, themes, and interaction states.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中检查共享 Semi Design 组件的真实交互与主题状态。

description.en: Sign in to an OpenCode Console account and serve every OpenCode model (console/go) in DeepSeek Harness, with live model capabilities, reasoning levels, and plan usage.
description.zh: 使用 OpenCode Console 账号登录，把 OpenCode 的全部 console/go 模型及其思考等级、套餐用量接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Sign in with a ZCode account (OAuth device authorization) to bring Zhipu Z.ai ZCode Start Plan models into DeepSeek Harness, following account entitlement, with model capabilities and per-model quota.
description.zh: 使用 ZCode 账号（OAuth 设备授权）登录，把智谱 Z.ai 的 ZCode Start Plan 模型按账号权益动态接入 DeepSeek Harness，含模型能力与按模型额度。
